text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The weather's so nice today,
so I'm gonna give you a bath!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum... soapy water smells so nice♪
Huh...? Whoa, the color is coming out...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, no, as long as I don't scrub too hard...!
It'll be fine, just rinse gently...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Heeeyyy... Did the color fade
eeeever so slightly?
